document.about: MAHLE engine kit catalogue (AP-90-12). Each page lists parts under one column header, in sections that a band names across the list (`CYLINDER BLOCK PARTS`, `ENGINE BEARINGS`, `FILTERS`).

notes: 2026-11-24 (#109): where a band opened a table the page cut at it, the table, read from its text, took the band for its header, naming every column under it.

checks.issue: `ENGINE BEARINGS` was the column header of the rod bearing rows under it.
`FILTERS` was the column header of the filter rows under it. (`WIX FILTERS` is a real column name in the interchange tables.)
